openSource.title: Found and fixed a startup bug in OpenMontage
openSource.description: OpenMontage is an open-source agent framework with {repoStars} stars. One of its skills was skipped on startup because its SKILL.md had no YAML frontmatter, and the video-toolkit skill was named in two different ways (kebab-case and snake_case). I reported it, then sent a fix that got merged.
